title: A forbidden comparison can get weight
hook: Two stated cases: explore the negative component in a toy fixed-effect decomposition.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the negative component in a toy fixed-effect decomposition affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Contrast, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the negative component in a toy fixed-effect decomposition in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.
